product.name: Idea Realisation Platform™ (IRP™)
product.description: A platform that guides users step-by-step from idea conception to execution with AI-driven personalized workflows and human mentorship.

product.name: Idea Funding Platform™ (IFP™)
product.description: A decentralized investment platform connecting validated ideas with funding through blockchain-enabled transparent mechanisms.

product.name: idea-L® GovToken
product.description: A utility and governance token enabling users to participate in platform governance, voting, staking, and access to features.

product.name: decentralised Venture Capital™ (deVC™) fund
product.description: A decentralized venture capital fund that raises, manages, and governs investment capital through tokenized ownership and DAO governance.

product.name: fast-Feasibility™
product.description: An AI-powered tool that provides rapid assessment of an idea’s potential by scoring its vision and viability.

product.name: LIVE-Feasibility™
product.description: An AI-based market readiness assessment tool that evaluates demand, timing, financials, and competition before launch.
